title: Protect main and keep CI action pins current
description: Follow-up from TASK-1.7. Pushes to main are not gated on CI, the SHA-pinned actions will silently age, and merged doit/* branches pile up on the remote. Branch protection is a GitHub repo setting the user applies; the task documents and verifies it.

nodes.title: Protect main and keep CI action pins current
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given .github/dependabot.yml, When Dependabot runs, Then it opens weekly update PRs for github-actions and npm
Given branch protection on main, When a pull request's CI check has not passed, Then GitHub blocks merging it (setting applied by the user; steps in README)
Given doit branches that are already merged into main, When the cleanup step in README is followed, Then they are deleted locally and on origin
